mean_cn: v.裹，包，捆；  n.披肩，围巾；包裹材料；结束，杀青
mean_en: to cover something completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present; to cover something/somebody in material, for example in order to protect it/them
sentence: She wrapped the gift with some colorful paper.
sentence_trans: 她用彩色的纸把礼物包了起来。
